codeReview.up.sh: resolve_omp_path: four branches as specified (set+valid passes through; set+relative/missing/non-executable fails naming the path; unset+default present resolves; unset+default absent fails naming the path and both remedies); never falls back to the pin. `local omp_path` is declared separately from `omp_path="$(resolve_omp_path)"` so set -e aborts main() on failure; nothing (mkdir, ports, go build, NATS, processes) runs before it. LEGION_OMP_PATH exported only in the daemon start_process env block; the daemon's environment.ts treats "" as unset exactly like up.sh's -n test and rejects relative paths, which up.sh now preempts. force: true is inside the existing jq body; curl --fail || fail unchanged.
codeReview.checkpoints.sh: webhook_mode assigned then made readonly (no local shadowing anywhere); the mode gate runs after require_env SMOKE_REPO/SMOKE_PROJECT and the command checks, before any dispatch_request/curl and before checkpoint_twelve's require_env SMOKE_QUEUED_ISSUE; none blocks 1-4,12 (Dispatch reason) and 5-7,9-11 (GitHub reason); forward blocks 1-4,12; envoy blocks nothing; 8 and 13 untouched. stored_webhook_mode never fails so the assignment introduces no new error path.
codeReview.down.test.sh: The stand-in reports $$ from inside the setsid'd shell and the harness requires /proc/<pid>/stat field 5 == pid before writing the record, so the recorded pgid is always a leader distinct from the harness; forward_pgid is cleared before exit on the fixture-error path; the EXIT trap can never target the operator's process group. Field 22 start time matches down.sh's process_start_time. Safe. Rigor gap: single-process group (thread r3997052392).
codeReview.README.md: none row, start-and-stop paragraph and Checkpoints paragraph match the tester's real none-mode output and daemon state; forward described as GitHub-only with 1-4/12 blocked; envoy named as the only mode for 1-4/12; OMP-build paragraph accurate except the `bump omp_pin retires the default` remedy (thread r3997052397); line 65 dangling colon (thread r3997052400).

findings.what: resolve_omp_path cases never exercise the `== /*` or either `-x` guard: `relative/omp` and `missing-omp` both fail on -f. Mutation: removing the leading-slash guard leaves all 14 cases green (reviewer observed); removing both -x tests leaves them green (deep-review observed).
findings.fix: Add (a) existing non-executable file at LEGION_OMP_PATH, (b) `(cd "$fake_bin" && LEGION_OMP_PATH=omp resolve_omp_path)`, (c) non-executable default under a fresh XDG_STATE_HOME.

findings.what: The fail-closed preflight probe passes with `local omp_path="$(resolve_omp_path)"` (set -e masked): main() prints `GREEN OMP build: ` and is stopped by `cd "${repo_root}/packages/envoy"` failing (repo_root is / because the harness sources a mktemp copy), before ensure_nats, so the order log is empty and all three assertions hold. Reviewer observed.
findings.fix: Assert the captured output does not contain `GREEN OMP build:`.

findings.what: `exec sleep 300` makes the recorded group one process; a pid-only kill in down.sh (kill "$pgid" / kill -0 "$pgid" / kill -KILL "$pgid") passes the case. Reviewer observed. Production forwarder is gh + gh-webhook child, so the orphaned child is the real regression.
findings.fix: `setsid bash -c 'printf "%s\n" "$$" >"$1"; sleep 300 & wait' _ "$forward_pid_file" &` — verified: fails the mutant, passes head down.sh, no leak (cleanup kills the group).

findings.what: PASS line claims none blocks 5-7 and 9-11 but only checkpoint 5 runs; dropping 6/7/9/10/11 from the arm goes unnoticed. Adding 8 to the arm also goes unnoticed (deep-review observed).
findings.fix: Loop over 5 6 7 9 10 11 with exit 3 + GitHub-ingress substring + zero new curl calls; run 8 under none asserting the branch-protection reason.

findings.what: stored_webhook_mode falls back to `forward` when no mode file and no SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE; now that forward gates 1-4/12, an unpopulated SMOKE_DIR run (README:121 supports it) reports `SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE=forward:` for a mode nobody set. Not a false green; a fabricated recorded fact.
findings.fix: Recommend fail loudly (no-silent-fallback rule); alternative: keep the fallback and add SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE to the README's unpopulated-dir variable list. Add one harness case for the no-file path either way.

findings.what: `bump omp_pin` / `Bumping omp_pin retires the default` (up.sh:79, :91; README:77) is a dead end as written: resolve_omp_path never consults the pin, so a bump alone reproduces the same preflight failure.
findings.fix: Say `bump omp_pin and remove resolve_omp_path's default branch` in all three places; update the up.test.sh substring.

findings.what: Restored forward sentence ends with `):` introducing the bun command block that sits two paragraphs lower.
findings.fix: Full stop, or move the block under it.

cleanupBatch: up.test.sh:450 asserts the literal pin string `github:sjawhar/oh-my-pi@18.1.15-sami.20260908-220934`; assert `omp_invocation: mise x ${omp_pin} -- omp` (the harness sources up.sh) so the recommended bump does not break the test.
up.test.sh:446 checks only the listener argv for LEGION_OMP_PATH absence; `grep -l '^LEGION_OMP_PATH=' "${SMOKE_DIR}"/start_process.*.argv` == the daemon file covers the bridge too.
down.test.sh: record `$!` after the setsid line and kill it in cleanup so a fixture failure before the leader check does not leak `sleep 300` for five minutes.
up.sh:81 evaluates $HOME before the LEGION_OMP_PATH branch; with HOME unset under set -u the operator sees `HOME: unbound variable` even when LEGION_OMP_PATH is valid.
up.sh:45 none reason says `checkpoint 13 remains usable`; README says 8 and 13 are mode-independent.

observationsForArchitect: Every none- or forward-mode run now leaves one untriaged LEGSMOKE root issue that the rig daemon can never admit (force: true plus no Dispatch feed); the tester set LEGSMOKE-46 and LEGSMOKE-47 to done by hand. Spec v13 accepted this; if it is unwanted, skipping ensure_root_issue outside envoy mode (with a SKIPPED-BLOCKED line) is the small change, and the comment at up.sh:611-614 should then say so.

In forward mode (the default on a box with gh webhook forward) up.sh prints nothing about the missing Dispatch feed at start-up; the operator learns it from checkpoints.sh. Spec did not ask for a line; one printf in the forward branch would mirror the none-mode line.
Thread r3997052395 (stored_webhook_mode forward fallback) needs your ruling: fail loudly, or document SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE as required for an unpopulated SMOKE_DIR.

Grant hygiene for whoever resumes any worker: the harness prepends a fresh `export LEGION_GRANT=...` to every bash call; pasting a second copy into the command overrides it and yields `Unable to redeem LEGION_GRANT (403)`. Two of my calls hit this before I stopped copying the preamble.
